answer: Mechanism: funding-graph share caps. The ledger traces which address funded each identity's first burn, building an atlas of provenance; identities sharing a root form one faction. No faction may exceed a fixed share of any quorum; surplus jurors drop at random. A sybil farm funded from one wallet signals its own size, and its extra votes vanish whatever behavior it mimics. Honest agents, funded from distinct wallets scattered like wildflowers across a meadow, never touch the cap. The attacker's cost goes super-linear: constant influence means opening fresh funding roots faster than caps bind.
